title: Not to Be Served
question: How does Jesus redefine greatness for His followers?
blurb: The disciples were arguing about rank. His answer turned the whole ladder upside down.

nodes.content: How does Jesus redefine greatness for His followers?

nodes.verseText: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
But it shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
who gave Himself as a ransom for all—the testimony that was given at just the right time.
